exact_statement: For every even d>=2 and integer r>=1, let b be the canonical d-bit quadratic bent sign, Q_r the product of r independent two-bit signs negative only at 11, and F=b+1_(y=0)(Q_r-1). Put delta=2^-d,t=sqrt(delta),alpha=2^-r,w=4^(1-r),e=delta/2,A=1-delta+2delta alpha^2,R_sigma=1+2sigma t(alpha-1)+delta[(alpha-1)^2+alpha^2], and D_y=sum_sigma N_sigma delta log2(A/R_sigma). Every selector influence is e and every core influence is a=1/2+delta(1-alpha). Retaining only a queried selector bit partner gives binary laws (1/2,1/2),(1-e,e) and total influence-weighted binary loss at least r delta(3d/8-1/2) for r>=2; at r=2^d this loss cannot be paid by a fixed multiple of one specified core influence. Retaining also the empty/nonempty occupancy of all other selector pairs gives complete four-cell laws (w/2,(1-w)/2,w/2,(1-w)/2) and (A,e(1-w),ew,e(1-w)). Its per-row loss is e w D_y/2, with 0<=D_y<=log2(3)<2, and its retained price is M_i^C/e=1+(w/2)[d+2r-1+log2 A]. Summing over ALL selectors, their retained prices plus discarded losses above total selector influence J=r delta cost less than (3/2)a, charged once to y_1. Consequently the enlarged root audit bill 2I_core+sum_selector(M_i^C+L_i^C)+J/ln2 is <=(7/2)I(F), and dominates B(F). All spectral atoms are positive and H(F)<=4I(F). This is a complete root-row ownership fixture, not a universal signed partition, hereditary terminal-child reserve, or FEI theorem.

exact_statement: For every even d>=4 and every Boolean sign g on r>=1 disjoint physical bits, let b(y)=(-1)^(sum_j y_(2j-1)y_(2j)), delta=2^-d, t=2^(-d/2), and F=b(y)+1[y=0](g(x)-1). Write hat b(R)=sigma_R t and a_V=hat g(V). For each relevant gate query i, retaining the residual gate mask V and sigma_R preserves the complete normalized derivative/reference KL exactly. Retaining only V loses influence-weighted KL L_i=delta a_i^2 D0_i, where D0_i=sum_sigma N_sigma delta log2(rho_i/c_(i,sigma)), N_sigma=(2^d+sigma 2^(d/2))/2, rho_i=1-delta+delta(a_empty^2+a_i^2), c_(i,sigma)=(sigma+t(a_empty-1))^2+delta a_i^2. The combined gate-row losses satisfy 0<=sum_i L_i<=2delta sum_i a_i^2<=2delta <=Inf_(y_1)(F)/4, and Inf_(y_j)(F)=1/2+delta(1-a_empty). This is a dedicated single reserve for precisely these quotient losses; no other charge, universal terminal payment, non-flat-core extension or full FEI conclusion is asserted.
